description: This file defines the SettingsFragment class, which manages the user preferences UI in the app. It handles preferences related to city selection, theme mode, notifications, calculation methods, and exact alarm settings, including permission handling and scheduling notifications.

classes.name: SettingsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that manages user preferences related to app settings such as city selection, theme, notifications, and alarm scheduling.

methods.name: onCreatePreferences
methods.description: Initializes preferences from XML, sets up preference change listeners, and updates UI summaries.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Updates the city preference summary and next scheduled notification when fragment resumes.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of notification permission requests, updating UI and scheduling accordingly.

methods.name: updateNextScheduledSummary
methods.description: Updates the summary text for the next scheduled notification setting.

methods.name: scheduleFromCurrentSettings
methods.description: Triggers rescheduling of notifications based on current preferences.

methods.name: openExactAlarmSettings
methods.description: Opens device-specific settings screens to allow the user to set exact alarm permissions.
